description: This file contains unit tests for the ScreenController in an iOS app, testing UI configurations, navigation, JavaScript evaluation, URL trust validation, and JSON parsing.

classes.name: ScreenControllerTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the ScreenController to validate UI behavior, navigation, scripting, and URL validation.

methods.name: mountScreen
methods.description: Helper function to initialize a ScreenController, create and retrieve its WebView.

methods.name: canvasModeConfiguresWebViewForTouch
methods.description: Tests that the WebView is configured correctly for touch input and appearance.

methods.name: navigateEnablesScrollForWebPages
methods.description: Tests that navigation to a URL enables scrolling and bouncing in the WebView.

methods.name: navigateSlashShowsDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Tests that navigating to '/' results in an empty URL string, indicating default behavior.

methods.name: evalExecutesJavaScript
methods.description: Asynchronously tests execution of JavaScript within the WebView and proper result handling.

methods.name: trustedRemoteA2UIURLMustMatchExactly
methods.description: Validates that only specific URLs are trusted for A2UI interactions, ignoring fragments.

methods.name: genericNavigationClearsTrustedRemoteA2UIURL
methods.description: Ensures that navigating away clears trust status for the A2UI URL.

methods.name: parseA2UIActionBodyAcceptsJSONString
methods.description: Checks that parsing A2UI action JSON works as expected.
